page_title: Sistava | Hire AI Employees to Run Your Business

sources.entry: Sistava — AI agent orchestration platform for deploying and operating multiple AI agents that run your business across sales, marketing, finance, and customer support. Reachable through Slack, WhatsApp, email, voice, Telegram, API, MCP, A2A, and webhooks. Each agent ships with full computer use on your own OS (screen vision, file access, browser automation, terminal execution, app control). Built

summary.name: Sistava
summary.one_liner: Sistava is an AI workforce platform where you hire pre-defined or custom AI employees to handle bounded, repeatable workflows in sales, marketing, support, operations, research and other departments.
use_cases: Delegating repeatable sales prospecting and follow-ups
Drafting marketing content and scheduling social posts
Preparing customer support replies for human approval
Drafting emails and preparing meeting notes
summary.what_it_does: Sistava lets a team choose an available AI employee role or define a custom one for a specific workflow. The team sets the role, business context, goals, tool access and review process for each employee. Supported apps are connected only after reviewing permitted access and actions. Work is delegated as bounded tasks, reviewed, and scope is expanded gradually. Departments listed include sales, marketing, support, operations, data, finance, product, design, people and legal, with legal limited to research and document work rather than legal advice.
notable: Pre-built AI employee roles across multiple departments plus custom workflow roles
Tool access limited to integrations and permissions the user enables
Human review and approval paths built into each workflow
Testimonials mention Instagram/Facebook scheduling and email drafting, though these are user claims
caveats: Plans start from $50/month, with included credits and employee capacity varying by tier; the page points to a pricing table for current details
Positioned as not a substitute for human judgment, accountability, or legal advice
Integration availability must be reviewed before connecting a workflow
